title: Clinical Reasoning & Presentation
sourceNote: Case-agnostic reasoning items, graded against the case’s expectedDifferential. Written by the team, not from a school document.

items.label: Submits a summary, differential and plan
Summary statement synthesises key history and exam findings
items.guidance: Judge ONLY the submitted summary. Full credit: concise one-liner + key positives and pertinent negatives from what the student actually elicited. Half: partial. Quote from the submission.

items.label: Leading diagnosis matches the case
items.guidance: Compare the student’s #1 diagnosis with the expected differential rank 1. Full credit for the same diagnosis (synonyms fine); half credit if it appears in their list but not first.

items.label: Considers reasonable alternatives
items.guidance: Credit if at least two other diagnoses from the expected differential (or equally reasonable ones) are listed.

items.label: Differential is supported by findings the student elicited
items.guidance: Credit if the summary/differential cites findings the student actually obtained (history answers or exam actions in the log), rather than findings they never elicited.

items.label: Initial plan is safe and appropriate
items.guidance: Judge the plan against standard initial management for the leading diagnosis (key investigations and first treatments). Half credit if reasonable but incomplete; 0 if unsafe or absent.

items.label: Finishes within the time limit (exam mode only)
